capabilities: resize images by scrolling the mousewheel
require a configurable modifier key (default left alt) while resizing
extras: The README only covers the core behavior and installation; installation is via the Obsidian community plugin browser.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to adjust an image's size directly while viewing a note.
summary: Image zoom plugin that resizes images in preview mode by scrolling the mousewheel while holding a configurable modifier key.
